entities.summary: Frederik Tiffels is a German professional ice hockey player who is a left winger for Eisbären Berlin of the Deutsche Eishockey Liga (DEL). He was drafted 167th overall in the 2015 NHL entry draft by the Pittsburgh Penguins.
